buying.title: The route to buying
buying.intro: Seven stops from first look to keys. The climb is in the middle; we carry the heavy parts.

stations.name: Explore
stations.what: Look widely: towns, streets and homes. Save what catches you, without commitment.
stations.us: We help you narrow towns by how you actually live, not by a price filter alone.

stations.name: Save
stations.what: Build a shortlist and a saved search so new homes find you first.
stations.us: We set up alerts that match what you told us, and send notes on the ones worth a drive.

stations.name: Tour
stations.what: See homes in person, in an order that makes sense on a map.
stations.us: We plan the day, point out what photographs hide and walk the street with you.

stations.name: Evaluate
stations.what: Compare the homes you love against recent sales and what each will cost to own.
stations.us: We pull comparable sales and give you a plain read on value and condition.

stations.name: Offer
stations.what: Write a written offer to purchase with terms that protect you.
stations.us: We shape price and terms with you, then talk with the listing agent directly.

stations.name: Navigate
stations.what: Inspection, purchase and sale agreement, appraisal, mortgage commitment.
stations.us: We keep every deadline and coordinate your attorney, lender and inspector.

stations.name: Close
stations.us: We're there for the walkthrough and the table, and after, when you need a plumber's number.

selling.title: The route to selling
selling.intro: Six stops from first conversation to closing. Most of the result is decided before the listing goes live.

stations.name: Understand
stations.what: What your home is worth to this market, and why.
stations.us: We walk the house, study recent sales and explain a pricing range with our reasoning.

stations.name: Prepare
stations.what: Repairs worth doing, repairs worth disclosing, and what goes into storage.
stations.us: We make the list with you and bring in painters, cleaners and stagers when they're worth it.

stations.name: Position
stations.what: Price, timing and the story the listing will tell.
stations.us: We choose a launch date around the market and your next move.

stations.name: Launch
stations.what: Photography, the property story, showings and open houses.
stations.us: We schedule the shoot for the light your rooms like and run every showing.

stations.name: Negotiate
stations.what: Offers, terms, inspection requests and the purchase and sale agreement.
stations.us: We compare offers on more than price and negotiate in plain view of you.

stations.name: Close
stations.what: Appraisal, final walkthrough, signing and handing over the keys.
stations.us: We coordinate attorneys and timing so your sale and your next home line up.
